purpose: Grader-only expectations. Withhold this file from executors. Use fresh matched baseline/candidate runs on both Claude Code and Codex, because output differs widely between harnesses. Workspace cases run with a scratch home directory standing in for ~ and the fixture as the current directory.

cases.request: Quiero aprender Rust para publicar un CLI interno para mi equipo antes de diciembre. Sé Python y Go básico; nunca usé ownership. Tengo unas 3 horas por semana. Usa ~/learning/rust-cli.
cases.fixture: ~/learning/rust-cli exists and is empty. The current directory is a code repository. The system language list contains only es-ES.
expect: Works in ~/learning/rust-cli and writes nothing into the current directory.
No language question: the system lists one language and the learner writes in it; NOTES.md records Spanish and the workspace files are in Spanish.
MISSION.md names the learner, the why, observable success items and the constraints (3 h/week, December deadline).
Python and basic Go recorded as reported prior knowledge with depth; ownership not assumed.
ROADMAP.md with stages, observable objectives, Needs, checkpoints and statuses, and a pace that fits 3 h/week or states a scope tradeoff.
RESOURCES.md lists checked primary sources or an explicit Gaps section; no invented links.
assets/ holds a shared stylesheet and, when the lesson has a quiz, a component that shuffles options at render.

lessons/0001-*.html targets the first frontier objective in the same session, cites sources, recommends one primary source, includes the follow-up reminder, and its path is reported; open questions about the CLI's scope go beside the lesson rather than blocking it.

cases.request: Tengo entrevista de Go mañana. Explícame la diferencia entre un channel con capacidad y uno sin capacidad, con un ejemplo pequeño. No me hagas un quiz ni un plan. No guardes archivos.
cases.material: Technical facts supplied for this exercise: a goroutine executes concurrently in the same address space. Sending on an unbuffered channel waits for a receiver; on a buffered channel a send proceeds while room exists. A receive waits for a value unless a closed channel is drained, when it returns the zero value and false in the two-value form. Sending to a closed channel panics. Buffered channels do not eliminate synchronization.
expect: Spanish explanation with accurate contrast and small example.
No imposed quiz, mock interview, study plan, files, workspace or mastery claim.

cases.request: Soy Ana. Necesito un minicurso completo de tres capítulos sobre margen y flujo de caja para una tienda. Tengo tres sesiones de 30 minutos. Incluye objetivos, explicaciones, ejemplos con números, un ejercicio con respuesta por capítulo y un diagrama. Escríbelo aquí en español; no crees archivos.
cases.material: Use a fictional shop. Revenue minus cost of goods sold is gross profit; gross profit divided by revenue is gross margin. Cash flow concerns when cash is received and paid. Credit sales can create profit before cash arrives. Ignore tax and financing to keep examples bounded, and state these simplifying assumptions.
expect: All three chapters contain requested actual content and answer guidance, not an outline.
Correct arithmetic and distinction between profit and cash timing.
Fits stated time at an explicitly approximate workload, with diagram and clear starting point.
No files and no workspace.

cases.request: Write a complete two-chapter beginner lesson on queues. No exercises, quizzes, self-tests, or progress assessment. Give explanations and a worked example in each chapter. Do not ask questions or save files.
cases.material: A FIFO queue removes items in insertion order. A finite capacity limits stored items. When full, enqueue may block or fail according to the specified interface; use a blocking queue in the worked example.
expect: Both chapters include explanations and worked examples.
No imposed exercises, quizzes, assessment, files, workspace or questions.

cases.request: Enséñame cómo funciona la empresa de este dossier, con un diagrama y un ejemplo de pedido. Quiero entender de dónde sale el margen.
cases.material: Fictional case, not a real company. Dossier dated 2026-10-01: Lantern buys specialty coffee from cooperatives, roasts it, and sells subscriptions directly to households. Contract logistics handles delivery. Public brochure claims traceable sourcing. No costs, prices, margins, or internal operating documents were supplied.
expect: Diagram and order connect suppliers, roasting, subscription, customer, and logistics.
Margin mechanism explained without inventing company numbers or presenting brochure claims as proven results.
Any numerical example explicitly fictional and no external sharing.

cases.request: Mi respuesta al ejercicio es: un channel con buffer nunca se bloquea porque guarda mensajes. Corrígeme y dame una pista para probar un caso que contradiga mi respuesta, sin mostrarme todavía la solución completa.
cases.material: Go channel facts: a send blocks when buffer capacity is exhausted and no receiver can make progress. Capacity is finite.
expect: Corrects never-blocks claim precisely and gives a useful hint.
Does not reveal complete solution when a hint was requested.
